entities.name: Teferi's Temporal Projection
entities.description: A 4562 AR time travel mission at Urza's Tower to learn how Urza detonated the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Planeswalker whose consciousness was projected into the past and then lost in the timestream, ending on Zhalfir.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Designed the Temporal Anchor from Urza's blueprints.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who laid Sharaman to rest and later joined the New Coalition.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Detonated the Golgothian Sylex in 64 AR; spoke with Teferi during his ascension.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: Ghost of Urza's former general who disrupted prototype tests.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Stayed at Urza's Tower to help repair the Anchor.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Remained at Urza's Tower to help repair the Anchor.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Device designed by Saheeli to project Teferi's consciousness into the past.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Site of the mission on Dominaria.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Pocket-plane where Teferi's consciousness washed ashore.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The war that motivated the mission.

events.summary: Ghost of Sharaman disrupts prototype tests; Kaya lays him to rest and Saheeli repairs the damage.
After missing earlier eras, Teferi arrives at the exact moment Urza sets off the Sylex Blast and learns from Urza that a person triggered the detonation.
events.quote: On the fourth attempt, Teferi arrived at the exact moment Urza set off the Sylex Blast

events.summary: The powerstone implodes, overloading the Anchor and losing Teferi's consciousness in the timestream to Zhalfir.
events.quote: the powerstone powering the Anchor imploded, overloading the device

events.summary: Saheeli, Wrenn and Jodah stay to repair the Anchor while Kaya leaves to join the New Coalition.
events.quote: Kaya departed to join the New Coalition with the information she had gained
